feat(docs): the landing showcase is an output-only card (rich-example-card-obsb.9yd) (#357)

* feat(docs): the landing showcase is an output-only card (rich-example-card-obsb.9yd)

The hero's live terminal now stands in the docs card's frame and output
panel (OutputCard in theme/RichExample.ts), with no code; RichShowcase.ts
keeps only the hero's sizing frame, loaded apart so the example terminal's
themes stay off every other page. RichLive was already gone (2pn renamed
it LiveScreen).

* fix(docs): the hero builds its card where its terminal is loaded (rich-example-card-obsb.9yd)

OutputCard in the eager RichExample.ts could only reach LiveScreen through
its async wrapper: on client navigation the hero stood empty until that
chunk arrived, one round trip after RichShowcase's own.
